text: The dentist was incredibly gentle! They explained the treatment process in detail and paid attention to every aspect. They kept me informed of everything they were doing beforehand, which made me feel very reassured. The procedure itself was painless and didn't take long. My previously decayed tooth is now perfectly smooth, like new! 😆✨

text: I finished my orthodontic treatment at the clinic in a year and a half, ahead of the two years the doctor had estimated. I went to the doctor every month for adjustments. One bracket came loose since I started the treatment (because I accidentally bit into something hard), but the doctor fixed it for free!! The first bracket came off without any charge. My teeth are now beautifully aligned, and I can smile confidently. The doctor is a specialist in orthodontics. I looked up the doctor's name online. If you're hesitant about finding a place to get braces, I highly recommend this clinic. The doctor is kind, and the staff are friendly. 😊😊😊😊
